raw_text: Kherson Regional Military Administration reports critical flooding in 12 settlements downstream. Rescue operations underway with boats evacuating residents. Water contamination from industrial sites is a major concern. Emergency shelters established in Kherson city for displaced residents. International humanitarian aid requested.
